features.name: Pier 1 and Harbor View Lawn
features.description: Pier 1 combines lawns, promenade, ferry access, restrooms, and broad harbor views. Use 1 Water Street for Access-A-Ride and expect heavy weekend crowds.

details.positionQuality: Pier 1, Brooklyn, Kings County, New York, 11201, United States
details.imageAlt: Pier 1 and Harbor View Lawn at Brooklyn Bridge Park

features.name: Empire Fulton Ferry and Jane's Carousel
features.description: Empire Fulton Ferry includes Jane's Carousel, lawns, food nearby, and classic bridge views. Carousel admission and hours are separate from park entry.

details.positionQuality: Empire Fulton Ferry, Brooklyn, Kings County, New York, 11201, United States
details.imageAlt: Empire Fulton Ferry and Jane's Carousel at Brooklyn Bridge Park

features.name: Main Street and Pebble Beach
features.description: Main Street and Pebble Beach sit between the Manhattan and Brooklyn bridges. The beach is for sitting and viewing; entering the river is unsafe and prohibited.

details.positionQuality: Main Street, Brooklyn, Kings County, New York, 11201, United States
details.imageAlt: Main Street and Pebble Beach at Brooklyn Bridge Park

features.name: Pier 2 sports courts
features.description: Pier 2 has courts, skating and recreation with seasonal hours, lockers, and a comfort station. Activities and concessions may have separate fees.

details.positionQuality: Brooklyn Bridge Park, 334, Brooklyn, Kings County, New York, 11201, United States
details.imageAlt: Pier 2 sports courts at Brooklyn Bridge Park

features.name: Pier 5 Picnic Peninsula
features.description: Pier 5 offers sports fields, a boathouse, picnic tables, and designated grills. Tables and grills are first-come unless a permit or event restriction applies.

details.positionQuality: Brooklyn Bridge Park, 334, Brooklyn, Kings County, New York, 11201, United States
details.imageAlt: Pier 5 Picnic Peninsula at Brooklyn Bridge Park

features.name: Pier 6 playgrounds and Water Lab
features.description: Pier 6 contains multiple playground zones and the seasonal Water Lab. Playgrounds close at sunset and water operation is weather-dependent.

details.positionQuality: Brooklyn Bridge Park, 334, Brooklyn, Kings County, New York, 11201, United States
details.imageAlt: Pier 6 playgrounds and Water Lab at Brooklyn Bridge Park

features.name: Pier 3 Greenway Terrace and labyrinth
features.description: Pier 3 combines a planted terrace, exploratory labyrinth, lawns, and harbor views; its quieter paths sit between the busier Pier 2 and Pier 5 activity zones.

details.positionQuality: Pier 3 Greenway Terrace, Brooklyn Bridge Park Greenway, Brooklyn, Kings County, New York, 11201, United States
details.imageAlt: Pier 3 Greenway Terrace and labyrinth at Brooklyn Bridge Park

features.name: Pier 4 Beach
features.description: Pier 4 Beach is a small engineered shoreline for observing the tidal river and launching approved programs; it is not a swimming beach.
